candidates.summary: Global mutable state & concurrency: every added transpiler test calls Transpile under t.Parallel, so a package-level cache on that path (gnoenv.RootDir, the resolver) would race, and CI runs no -race
candidates.failure_scenario: Two parallel subtests of TestMixedDocGroupMatchesInertEquivalent resolve the errors import at once through a shared lazily-filled map and the race detector reports a write/read race

candidates.summary: The marker's claim that 'gno is nobody's tool name' holds only while no gno tooling reads a //gno: pragma; one that did would act on every neutralized line
candidates.failure_scenario: A gno linter or the VM reading //gno:<name> pragmas treats //gno:removed-directive as one of its own
candidates.verify_by: grep -rnE '//gno:[a-z]' over gnovm, gno.land and examples, *.go and *.gno, excluding the marker itself: expect no reader
